mapper.sql: select c.id, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.cate, s.config_name as catename, u.nickname as createrNickname, c.title from cms_info c left join acl_user u on c.creater = u.id left join sys_config s on s.is_deleted = 0 and s.config_key = 'artcle_cate' and s.config_value = c.cate

select c.id, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.cate, s.config_name as catename, u.nickname as createrNickname, c.title, d.content from cms_info c left join cms_info_detail d on c.id = d.id left join acl_user u on c.creater = u.id left join sys_config s on s.is_deleted = 0 and s.config_key = 'artcle_cate' and s.config_value = c.cate
